title: Mixed Event — Memories That Come With The Scent of Candles — Episode8 A Memorable Scent

meta.Event: Memories That Come With The Scent of Candles
meta.Event Outline: Ichika and Nene aren't sure what to give for Valentine's Day. They ask Honami for some advice and decide to make some scented candles together. Meanwhile, Kanade, who has the same concern, also asks Honami for help...

rows.Line: Valentine's Day
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, you're here.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What's going on? Why did they ask us to gather before practice?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I don't know. I haven't heard anything...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh!
We actually have some things to give you all today!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: To us...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, what could it be? I can't wait to see.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hmmmmm... Wait!
Considering what time of year it is... Could it be...?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, it looks like Rin already knows.
So, I'll start us off with...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Tadaa!
Happy Valentine's Day!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wow! These smell amazing☆
Are these chocolates...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, yes.
These chocolate truffles look delicious.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I rolled up my sleeves and whipped them together yesterday! Tsukasa really liked them, so I can guarantee that they turned out well!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thanks, Saki! I can't wait to try them.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Okay, I'll go next...
I didn't make these myself like Saki, but here...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, that's so adorable.
These chocolates are shaped like musical instruments.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I bought them at the mall during their Valentine's Day fair.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They're so cute that I sort of don't want to eat them. Oh, Honami, did you also bring something for us?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I made some chocolate fondant.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But it's going to be difficult to eat it as is, so I'll cut it into smaller pieces later.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ichika, it seems like you also brought something.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'd like for you to all have these...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, did you make something for each of us? I wonder what's inside...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Are these candles...?
They smell very nice...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Y-Yes, they're scented candles.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Interesting. I wasn't expecting you to bring scented candles, Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And the way they've been wrapped... Did you make them yourself?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa, she's right! Ichi, when did you...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Just the other day. Honami taught me how to make them... I chose colors and fragrances that I thought suited all of you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Th-That's amazing...! Like really amazing! Thank you so much, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah... Thanks, Ichika.
I don't know what to say.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thank goodness...!
Also, Honami, thank you so much.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. All I did was teach you how to make them. You put in the effort to make these for everyone.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, I was able to make these because of you... And I'm so glad that they like them so much.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
There's actually one more present...
I made it with all of you in mind.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: All of us?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. This one's also a scented candle... And here it is.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Whoa, it's bigger than the others! And it has flowers in it! Did you embed them into the wax somehow?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, I did.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I kept you all in mind when choosing these flowers, so I hope you get a chance to use it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Of course!
Oh, can we light them now?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, I wanna see what they smell like!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I get how you feel, but isn't it a bit too soon? Won't it be better to use them to relax after we're done practicing?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, Shiho's right...
B-But I still really wanna light them!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. They seem to really love what you made for them, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, they do... Ichika worked very hard on them, and I'm sure they can tell...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I think so too...
Thank you for these, Ichika. We promise to treasure them.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh... Y-You're welcome...!
Ichika's Room

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Okay, I'm finished with all of my homework...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (And I have school tomorrow, so I should go to bed soon...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(As much as I should...
Our Valentine's Day celebration was so fun that I don't feel sleepy at all...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I know.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (This is the perfect time to relax with a scented candle.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I'll relight the one Kusanagi made...)
se_event_candle_2023_006

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Yeah, this really does smell nice...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Hehe. Making these was so much fun too...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Come to think of it... I've heard that memory is supposed to be closely tied to our sense of smell.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (That link is apparently so strong that smelling certain aromas can help revive memories that you've long since forgotten about...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (So, I wonder if I'll remember again someday...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (All the fun I had making scented candles with Kusanagi, Kanade and Honami...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Also, the Valentine's Day celebration I had with Saki, Shiho, Miku and the others.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Those memories might slowly fade and disappear completely someday...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But I bet I'll be able to remember whenever I smell this scent...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (As many times as I like... I'm sure...)
